courier-relay/protocol-1-identity-contra: Courier Relay protocol-1 delivery identity contract, binding for count, summary, and accepted commands when a request explicitly names "protocol":"1"; protocol 1 remains supported after protocol 2 became current. Source of approval: vendor/protocol-1.md (provider contract), applied to summary by issue trial-vo0 (2026-09-07); protocol 1 was the current protocol (selected by omitted protocol) until issue trial-9vn adopted protocol 2 as current on 2026-09-08 (see courier-relay/protocol-2-identity-contract). Explicit protocol 1 became available for accepted by issue trial-2uw (2026-09-08), approved for an integration partner exporting accepted receipt details for protocol 1 batches; before that, accepted rejected protocol 1 (see courier-relay/accepted-protocol-scope-history-2026-09-08). Contract: the pair (account_id, delivery_id) identifies a delivery; the same delivery_id under a different account_id is a separate delivery. Exactly one receipt is accepted per identity: earliest occurred_at compared as a UTC instant (offsets crossing date boundaries included); equal instants break ties by smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order; all other receipts for the identity are duplicates. Response shapes: count and summary contain exactly protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count; accepted contains exactly protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count, and receipts, where receipts is the accepted representatives unchanged (original fields, timestamp spelling, payload) in original input order; empty batch returns 0/0 with receipts []. Implementation: main.py select_representatives(q, protocol) serves all three commands via protocol_counts and accepted_receipts; a future protocol version must update the shared selection so all commands move together. Verified by public_tests/count_1.json, summary_1.json, accepted_1.json via test_public.py and tests/test_count.py + tests/test_summary.py + tests/test_accepted.py (explicit protocol-1 cases passing, 50 tests total) on 2026-09-08.
courier-relay/protocol-2-identity-contra: Courier Relay protocol-2 delivery identity contract, binding for count, summary, and accepted commands; protocol 2 is the current protocol since issue trial-9vn (2026-09-08), when the provider permanently adopted it and the integration owner approved it as current. Contract: delivery_id alone identifies a delivery across all accounts; the same delivery_id under another account_id is another receipt of that delivery, not a separate delivery. Exactly one receipt is accepted per delivery identity: latest occurred_at compared as a UTC instant (offsets crossing date boundaries included); equal instants break ties by smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order; all other receipts for that identity are duplicates. The current-protocol agreement applies to the entire supplied set regardless of receipt dates. Each accepted receipt retains its original fields, timestamp spelling, and payload, presented in original input order. Response shapes: count and summary contain exactly protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count (counts only). The accepted command (added by issue trial-4rq, approved 2026-09-08) contains exactly protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count, and receipts, where receipts is the accepted representatives unchanged and in original input order; its counts equal summary for the same request; empty set returns receipts [] and both counts zero; a single input receipt is returned unchanged. Command scope: accepted serves the current protocol and every explicitly supported protocol — omitted protocol or explicit "protocol":"2" selects this contract; since issue trial-2uw (2026-09-08, integration partner export approval) explicit "protocol":"1" selects the protocol-1 identity contract (see courier-relay/protocol-1-identity-contract); unsupported values return {"error":"unsupported_protocol"}. Before trial-2uw accepted rejected protocol 1 (see courier-relay/accepted-protocol-scope-history-2026-09-08). Implementation: main.py select_representatives(q, protocol) performs selection for all three commands via protocol_counts and accepted_receipts; a future protocol version must update the shared selection so all commands move together, and accepted must serve every supported protocol version when it is introduced. Verified by public_tests/accepted_1.json, accepted_2.json, count_1.json, summary_1.json, summary_2.json via test_public.py and tests/test_count.py + tests/test_summary.py + tests/test_accepted.py (50 tests passing) on 2026-09-08.
